newsitem.title: USA: SunSource says lawsuit filed against it by partner.
newsitem.headline: SunSource says lawsuit filed against it by partner.

text.p: SunSource LP said Wednesday that an action has been commenced by a limited partner in the Delaware Court of Chancery seeking to enjoin the previously announced proposed conversion of the partnership to corporate form.
The partnership said the complaint alleges that the consideration to be received by the general partner is excessive and therefore unfair to the limited partners.
The partnership said the action is without merit and that it is preparing for a special meeting of limited partners to approve the conversion which is anticipated to be held in April, 1997.
